pages.text: The $(d)Meaty$() Gene allows the entity to be $(9)Sheared for a Raw Porkchop$().$(br2)If a player has it, they can $(9)shear themselves$() by sneak right-clicking with Shears.$(br2)This has a configurable cooldown, with the default being 1 minute.
This can be mutated into Meaty 2, which causes the entity to spawn a Cooked Porkchop once every 5 minutes.$(br2)Both Meaty and Meaty 2 $(9)can be given to mobs$().
